# Hood rest stop modification with shock bushings

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove existing rubber hood stops and place cut shock bushing halves over studs where the hood rests. [t927]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the existing rubber hood stops.
2. [Partial] Cut a pair of shock bushings in half lengthwise.
3. Place the cut bushing halves over the studs where the hood rests to provide support and resistance against spring clips.

_Procedure reported by [t927]._

## Parts

- Shock bushings [t927]

## Tips & gotchas

- This modification provides a surface for the hood to rest on after removing rubber stops. [t927]
- The cut bushings offer resistance against the spring clips. [t927]
